SOTHIS-PURIFY.title: Purify
SOTHIS-PURIFY.description: If used on an ally, gain block. If used on an enemy, deal damage.
SOTHIS-CORRUPT.title: Corrupt
SOTHIS-CORRUPT.description: If used on an enemy, heal the enemy. If used on an ally, deal damage.
SOTHIS-RELIEF.title: Relief
SOTHIS-RELIEF.description: Allies with [gold]Relief[/gold] gain block at the end of their turn. Enemies with [gold]Relief[/gold] take damage at the end of their turn. Decrease [gold]Relief[/gold] by 1 every turn.
SOTHIS-SOUL_HEAT.title: Soul Heat
SOTHIS-SOUL_HEAT.description: Whenever you deal Damage or apply [gold]Relief[/gold], increase [gold]Soul Heat[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue] this turn.
SOTHIS-AFFLICTION.title: Affliction
SOTHIS-AFFLICTION.description: Allies with [gold]Affliction[/gold] take damage at the end of their turn. Enemies with [gold]Affliction[/gold] heal at the end of their turn.
SOTHIS-FLAMMABLE_CHAKRAM.title: Flammable Chakram
SOTHIS-FLAMMABLE_CHAKRAM.description: Whenever you deal damage, apply [gold]Relief[/gold] to the target. Decrease [gold]Flammable Chakram[/gold] by 1 every turn.
SOTHIS-HOURGLASS_MASTERY.description: Generate a free, [gold]Exhaust[/gold], and [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of the next card you play, then decrease [gold]Hourglass Mastery[/gold] by 1.
SOTHIS-HOURGLASS_MASTERY.title: Hourglass Mastery
SOTHIS-SANDS_OF_TIME.description: Percentage chance to generate a free, [gold]Exhaust[/gold], and [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of the next card you play, then decrease [gold]Sands Of Time[/gold] by 5.
SOTHIS-SANDS_OF_TIME.title: Sands Of Time
SOTHIS-BEHENIAN_HOURGLASS.description: Gain [gold]Hourglass Mastery[/gold] at the start of every turn.
SOTHIS-BEHENIAN_HOURGLASS.title: Behenian Hourglass
